job.title: Internal Sales - Building Materials
job.description:
About the Company
Ceilings by Design is one of Queensland's most established building materials suppliers, with more than 30 years supplying hospitals, schools, office and retail fit-outs across QLD. The Morningside team of around 25 works from a purpose-built facility designed to support the business's ongoing growth. It's a hardworking, no-nonsense team where leadership is accessible and performance is genuinely acknowledged.

About the Role
Join the internal sales team at Morningside and own the trade enquiry pipeline from first contact through to quote delivery. If you've got experience in construction, building materials or trade supply or you're simply drawn to that world and want to build a career in it this is a supportive environment to do exactly that.

You'll work alongside an experienced internal and external sales team, building product knowledge and customer relationships from day one. No tools required. No cold calls. Full training provided.

Duties
  • Manage inbound trade enquiries from builders, contractors, project managers and internal stakeholders
  • Prepare accurate project quotes and pricing using estimating software
  • Process sales orders and coordinate delivery schedules
  • Support external sales representatives with quote preparation and customer follow-up
  • Build and maintain relationships with repeat project clients, finding the right product solution for each job
Skills & Experience
  • Background or genuine interest in construction, building materials or trade supply — you understand (or want to learn) how builders and contractors work
  • Sharp attention to detail — quoting accuracy matters, every time
  • Confident communicator, comfortable with walk-in and phone enquiries
  • A solutions mindset — you enjoy finding the right product fit for a customer's project, not just processing an order
  • Quick to pick up new systems and processes
  • Team-oriented, reliable, and happy in a varied, hands-on day
Benefits
  • $65,000–$75,000 base salary + Superannuation
  • Permanent, full-time — genuine job security and career stability from day one
  • Monday to Friday only — no nights, no weekends, no on-call
  • Full structured onboarding, product training and mentoring provided
  • Stable, established customer base — warm inbound enquiries only, no cold calling
  • Supportive, varied team environment with leadership who work alongside you, not over you
  • Morningside, Brisbane
How to Apply

Click APPLY to submit your application. For a confidential discussion, contact Dallas at dallas.w@giide.com.au or call 1300 160 867.

Ceilings by Design is working exclusively with recruitment partner Giide for this permanent position. Full Australian work rights required.

job.title: Internal Sales Representative - Building Materials
job.description:
About the Company
Our client is one of NSW's most established commercial ceiling and interior lining suppliers, serving builders, contractors and project managers across Sydney and beyond. Based at Kings Park in Western Sydney, the team is built on technical product knowledge, accurate quoting, and the kind of repeat-customer relationships that only come from doing the job right. High standards. Consistent delivery. A team that takes ownership.

About the Role
As our client's new Internal Sales Representative, you'll join the internal sales team and take ownership of inbound trade enquiries from first contact through to accurate quote delivery and order management. You'll work directly with builders, contractors and project managers who depend on your accuracy and reliability to keep their projects on track. No cold calling. No trade tools required. The enquiries come to you, your job is to turn them into long-term customer relationships through accuracy, follow-through, and product knowledge you'll build from day one.

Duties
  • Manage inbound trade enquiries from builders, contractors and project managers
  • Prepare accurate project quotes and pricing using estimating tools
  • Process confirmed orders and coordinate delivery scheduling
  • Build and maintain long-term relationships with repeat commercial clients
  • Support the external sales team with product knowledge and pipeline management
Skills & Experience
  • Confident communicator, comfortable engaging with builders, contractors and project teams
  • Strong numeracy and attention to detail
  • Background in internal sales, trade counter, customer service, retail, or commercial admin
  • Comfortable learning estimating or order management systems
  • Reliable, organised, and follows through
Prior experience in building materials or construction related industry exposure is a bonus, not a requirement. If you understand how to deal with builders and contractors and can quote accurately, we want to hear from you.

Benefits
  • $65,000–$75,000 base salary + Superannuation
  • Permanent, full-time role with great job security from day one, not casual or contract
  • Monday to Friday only; no shift work, no nights, no weekends, no on-call
  • Established customer base meaning warm inbound enquiries 
  • Full structured product training provided; no prior ceiling industry knowledge required
  • Career development pathway into commercial building materials sales
  • Kings Park, Western Sydney
How to Apply
Click APPLY to submit your resume. For a confidential discussion contact Giide

Giide is managing this search on behalf of our client for this permanent position. Full Australian work rights required.

job.title: Technical Sales Respresentative
job.description:

Our client is one of Australia's leading distributors of advanced automation, electrical and instrumentation solutions trusted by manufacturers, engineers, contractors and industry leaders nationally. Backed by highly regarded product brands and a genuine role in building Australia's sovereign manufacturing and industrial capability, they're a business genuinely going somewhere, and now expanding that momentum into South East Queensland.

About the Role
This is a rare opportunity to build something real. As our client expands its South East Queensland presence, you'll be at the front line providing automation, electrical and instrumentation solutions to some of the region's most advanced manufacturers and industrial businesses. You'll bring solutions to companies solving real challenges, across sectors from manufacturing to infrastructure to advanced industry. This is a role built on autonomy: you'll own how you build your patch, working alongside an existing SEQ team member as our client's presence in the region grows toward a larger, established team over time. There's genuine progression on offer as that growth happens.

Duties
  • Build genuine relationships with South East Queensland's leading manufacturers, engineers and industrial businesses
  • Represent a portfolio of world-class automation, electrical and instrumentation brands
  • Identify and shape solutions that solve real customer challenges supported by technical product specialists
  • Own your own success, manage your patch and pipeline with genuine autonomy
Skills & Experience
  • A genuine relationship-builder with a consultative, curious approach to sales
  • Comfortable working autonomously and driving your own success
  • Industry or technical exposure (automation, instrumentation, electrical, industrial) is a plus, attitude and drive count just as much
  • Full driver's licence and Australian work rights
Culture & Team
You'll be joining at a genuine growth point working alongside an existing South East Queensland team member as our client builds out a larger regional presence over time. Backed by experienced technical specialists and genuine autonomy, this is a role for someone who wants to build something, not just fill a seat.

Benefits
  • $100,000–$120,000 + Super, Car, Phone, Laptop
  • Company car, phone and laptop
  • Genuine autonomy — ownership over your own success, not micromanaged 
  • Real progression, a ground-floor seat as the team grows
  • Backed by leading, in-demand product brands and genuine technical expertise
How to Apply
Submit your resume using Quick Apply or contact the team at Giide.

job.title: Fabricator/ Assembly - Aluminium
job.description:
Brisbane Aluminium is one of Queensland's leading manufacturers and suppliers of aluminium partition systems, frames, doors and windows — supplying commercial construction and fit-out projects across South East Queensland.
We're expanding the production team and have multiple permanent positions available now.

What's on offer
  • $60,000–$70,000 + superannuation — based on experience
  • Permanent full-time — not labour hire, not casual
  • Monday to Friday, 6:00am–3:00pm — no nights, no weekends
  • 4 weeks annual leave + personal leave entitlements
  • Regular team events and genuine staff recognition
  • Staff training and development
  • Free parking — Morningside facility

The facility
In 2025, Brisbane Aluminium completed a full expert layout and fitout of the Morningside facility designed with workflow efficiency and accessibility front of mind. Every workstation, storage area, and production line has been positioned to reduce unnecessary movement, keep the floor clear, and make the job easier from the moment you start.

The work
You'll be working in a structured production environment assembling and fabricating aluminium frames, doors, windows and partition systems for commercial projects across Brisbane.

Day-to-day:
  • Fabricating and assembling aluminium frames, doors, windows and partition components
  • Reading and working from technical drawings and cut lists
  • Using hand and power tools accurately and safely
  • Maintaining quality standards across all finished products
  • Preparing and staging finished products for dispatch
  • Supporting the team across the production floor as required
Who we're looking forWe're building a team for the long term. We're not looking for a specific trade ticket — we're looking for people who work hard, take pride in the product, and show up consistently.
You'll be a good fit if you have:
  • Experience in a production, assembly, manufacturing, or trade environment
  • Comfortable with hand and power tools — aluminium or other materials
  • Able to read basic drawings or a willingness to learn
  • A safety-first approach and a positive attitude
  • Physically capable of lifting up to 25kg and working on your feet
New to aluminium? That's fine. If you've worked in construction, trade assistance, joinery, glazing, steel fabrication, shopfitting, or any hands-on production role the fundamentals transfer. We'll back the right person with on-the-job training. Forklift licence is a bonus but not required.

The culture This is a workplace that invests in its people not just the work. The team is close-knit and the business puts genuine effort into making it a place people want to be. Regular team events, meaningful staff recognition, and leadership that actually notices the effort you put in.
The stability Permanent employment from day one. Consistent hours, reliable workflow, and a business with 30+ years supplying major Brisbane construction projects. This is not project-based work or labour hire. It's a real job with real job security.

Apply now — multiple roles available, interviewing this week.

Call 1300 160 867 or submit your resume. All applications treated with confidentiality.
Giide is recruiting these roles on behalf of Brisbane Aluminium. Permanent positions only. Full working rights in Australia required.
